competences.description: Attacks the enemy target, recovers the HP of the ally with the lowest HP ratio by 15% and creates a shield proportional to your MAX HP for 2 turns.

effets.note: Recovers HP of the ally with lowest HP ratio

effets.description: The Shield will absorb a fixed amount of damage.

competences.description: Removes all harmful effects on the target ally and recovers both your HP and the target's HP by 25% each.

Attacks the enemy target to inflict damage, steals the beneficial effects on the enemy and transfers the harmful effects granted on yourself. In addition, you and the target's Attack Power, excluding the boss, will be switched while the skill is on cooldown if the target's Attack Power is higher than yours. If you fail to switch the Attack Power, the skill cooldown of [Attack! Attack!] is decreased by 2 turns.

effets.description: Remove a beneficial effect and take it for yourself
Removes a debuff from casting monster and applies it to the target monster.
